name: How can I stop cold air from coming through my windows temporarily?

mainEntity.name: How can I stop cold air from coming through my windows temporarily?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a temporary fix, you can use various methods to reduce cold air drafts. Options include applying temporary window film kits, which create an insulating layer, or using rope caulk to seal small gaps around the frame. Draft snakes placed along the windowsill can also help block air movement. Heavy curtains or thermal drapes can offer some insulation. These solutions are effective for short-term relief but do not address underlying structural issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Temporarily stop drafts with window film, rope caulk, draft snakes, or heavy curtains. These provide short-term relief from cold air.
